parts.text: Just sending a final reminder about a PhD position in Australia, project details below, and more information at:

We’re very open to a wide range of backgrounds, we expect applicants will be strong in some parts of the project with no experience in others.

You can contact richard.savery@canberra.edu.au before submitting your EOI to discuss your application and project proposal.

The final application is due 30th of April, however it is encouraged to get in contact soon to discuss eligibility and the proposal.
